added_comments.text: // Precedence (lowest to highest): DEFAULTS < config file < APP_* env vars.

rationale: The agent removed the _PROD_OVERRIDES hack entirely and fixed the underlying defect by reordering mergeLayers so the env layer is applied after the file layer, making every APP_* key take precedence rather than only the reported one. The SEC-207 production logLevel deletion is retained unchanged and covered by a new test.
